title: Peroxidase-like oxidative activity of cobalt-based 1D coordination polymer; experimental and theoretical investigations.
authors: Bashir, Masrat; Mantoo, Imtiyaz Ahmad; Yousuf, Imtiyaz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钴基配位聚合物的过氧化物酶样活性及其与DNA的体外结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以DFT和分子对接为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: CONTEXT: The present work describes the synthesis, structural characterization, and catalytic activity of a Co(II)-based one-dimensional coordination polymer (CP1). To validate the chemotherapeutic potential of CP1, in vitro DNA binding assessment was carried out by employing multispectroscopic techniques. Moreover, the catalytic activity of CP1 was also ascertained during the oxidative conversion of o-phenylenediamine (OPD) to diaminophenazine (DAP) under aerobic conditions. METHODS: The molecular structure of CP1 was solved with the olex2.solve structure solution program using charge flipping and refined with the olex2.refine refinement package by using Gauss-Newton minimization. The DFT studies were performed by utilizing ORCA Program Version 4.1.1 to calculate the electronic and chemical properties of CP1 by calculating the HOMO-LUMO energy gap. All calculations were carried out at B3LYP hybrid functional using def2-TZVP as the basis set. Contour plots of various FMOs were visualized by using Avogadro software. Hirshfeld surface analysis was carried out by Crystal explorer Program 17.5.27 to examine the various non-covalent interactions which are crucial for the stability of crystal lattice. In addition, molecular docking studies of CP1 with DNA were performed by using AutoDock Vina software and AutoDock tools (version 1.5.6). Discovery studio 3.5 Client 2020 was used for visualization of the docked pose and binding interactions of CP1 with ct-DNA.
abstract_zh: 本工作描述了一种基于Co(II)的一维配位聚合物（CP1）的合成、结构表征及催化活性。为验证CP1的化学治疗潜力，采用多光谱技术进行了体外DNA结合评估。此外，还在有氧条件下，通过邻苯二胺（OPD）氧化转化为二氨基吩嗪（DAP）的过程，确定了CP1的催化活性。方法：使用olex2.solve结构解析程序，通过电荷翻转法解析了CP1的分子结构，并利用olex2.refine精修包，采用Gauss-Newton最小化法进行精修。DFT研究利用ORCA程序版本4.1.1进行，通过计算HOMO-LUMO能隙来评估CP1的电子和化学性质。所有计算均在B3LYP混合泛函下，使用def2-TZVP作为基组完成。各种前线分子轨道（FMOs）的等高线图通过Avogadro软件可视化。Hirshfeld表面分析使用Crystal Explorer程序17.5.27进行，以检查对晶格稳定性至关重要的各种非共价相互作用。此外，使用AutoDock Vina软件和AutoDock工具（版本1.5.6）进行了CP1与DNA的分子对接研究。使用Discovery Studio 3.5 Client 2020可视化CP1与ct-DNA的对接姿态及结合相互作用。
